definitions.quote: Academic Misconduct: Behaviours perpetrated by individuals or institutions that transgress ethical standards held in common between other individuals and/ or groups in institutions of education, research or scholarship.
Cheating: Actions that attempt to get advantage by means that undermine values of integrity

Plagiarism: Presenting work / ideas taken from other sources without proper acknowledgement.
Impersonation: Misrepresentation or impersonating an individual for the purpose of cheating.

Fabrication: Fabrication in the context of research means making up data, experiments, or other significant information in proposing conducting or reporting research.
Text-matching software: Software that searches a text-based document and provides a list of in-text similarities and references to matching sources.
Viva: Oral defence of your thesis or submitted piece of work.
